purpose: Candidate-only data fix for resident spawn refusals on the isolated 48 cm map, grounded in the real-RHI PIE receipt named in evidenceReceipt. It stages a candidate copy of the people-v3 directory with four authored routes moved clear of the actual blocking components, repoints ONLY the candidate map's RELEASE_PeopleV3Population actor at that copy, and moves the five pre-placed pilot bodies to their converted selected48 supports so the pilot population can start. Main map, shared people.json, C++ and held artwork are untouched. Physical capsule, floor tolerance and route-length rules are unchanged.
